notes.nursery_seeding_process: Sow 1 tomato seed per cell in 72-cell or 50-cell trays. Use a well-draining seedling mix. Germinate at 22-26 degrees C with bottom heat for 5-7 days. Maintain at 18-22 degrees C after emergence. Transplant at 6-8 true leaves or 5-6 weeks from seeding. Harden off over 7-10 days before field planting.
